description: Attach an existing matrix under the matrix of the level above (business unit under group, site under business unit), or detach it with an empty parent_matrix_id. Links from its elements to the old parent are cleared. Refused if it would create a loop or a fifth level.

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix to attach (required)

parent_matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix of the level above; empty string to detach (required)

name: set_matrix_parent
title: Set parent matrix
